description: Update issue fields. status / assignee / priority / type / category / milestone are given by NAME — the default statuses also accept English, Japanese and Vietnamese names (Open/未対応, In Progress/処理中, Resolved/処理済み, Closed/完了). Other keys (dueDate, startDate, summary, description, …) go to the API as-is. Dry run unless send=true. Never set a customer's issue to Closed.

attachments.description: Local file paths to upload and attach (images, documents, …). Uploaded only when send=true

ref.description: Issue: a Backlog URL, "<space> <KEY>" (e.g. "internal DEV-42") or a bare key known from a sync profile

send.description: false (default) = dry run: returns the exact request. true = actually send — only after the user approved it

name: update_issue
